core_ideas.idea: Learn DSA actively with personalized prompts, not passive tutorials
core_ideas.why: ChatGPT prompts adapt to your level, mistakes and pace, and teach intuition, debugging, pattern recognition and complexity instead of watching the same video as everyone
core_ideas.trade_off: Slower and requires you to think, break down problems and practice deliberately; no instant dopamine or finished code to copy

core_ideas.idea: Deep coding skill comes from hidden practice sites that build thinking
core_ideas.why: VisuAlgo, Project Euler, Exercism, Codewars and Refactoring Guru build algorithm intuition, math reasoning, clean code and design instincts over popularity
core_ideas.trade_off: These sites won't go viral or feel productive instantly; they require consistency to build real engineering instincts

core_ideas.idea: System design and database indexing are the foundations for scale and speed
core_ideas.why: The 16 core concepts (distributed systems, idempotent APIs, JWT, consistent hashing, service discovery, Bloom filters, saga pattern, RPC) plus 15 index types (B-Tree, B+Tree, Hash, LSM, Inverted, R-Tree, Trie etc.) show how to pick the right structure to make systems reliable and queries orders of magnitude faster
core_ideas.trade_off: More concepts to learn and wrong choices hurt you; a well-designed index speeds up, a wrong index slows everything down

core_ideas.idea: Production agentic AI needs explicit pattern choices, not just prompting
core_ideas.why: Choose single vs multi-agent based on task complexity, latency vs accuracy, cost and human oversight; then implement with deterministic logic + LLM reasoning, graph orchestration, vector retrieval and deployable APIs
core_ideas.trade_off: Multi-agent and RAG systems are more powerful but cost more, add latency, and need vector storage (ChromaDB), orchestration (ADK) and monitoring

core_ideas.idea: Ship premium-feeling apps fast by composing APIs and using free hosting
core_ideas.why: Mapbox for maps, Resend for email, Clerk for auth, Stream for chat/feeds/video, Cloudinary for media, plus Fly.io, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, Google Cloud free tier etc. let you deploy and showcase without building everything from scratch
core_ideas.trade_off: Faster to start but you depend on vendors, free-tier limits, and less control over customization and scaling
